description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of MCP servers
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-mcp-servers --biz-q mcp --visibility TENANT --max-results 20 --next-token 12345 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMcpServers

parameters.help_en: The search keyword for a fuzzy search on MCP Server names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，按 MCP Server 名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: The visibility level for filtering the results
parameters.help_zh: 按可见性级别过滤，可传多个
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The next page token from a previous response. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token。首次查询不传；后续查询传上一次返回的 NextToken 获取下一页
parameters.name: next_token
